reck.definition:
v. t. To make account of; to care for; to heed; to regard.
v. t. To concern; -- used impersonally.
v. i. To make account; to take heed; to care; to mind; -- often
   followed by of.
reck.translation:
vt. 介意, 和...相关
vi. 有关系, 介意

recked.translation: v. 顾虑( reck的过去式和过去分词 )

reckful.translation:
reckful (comparative more reckful, superlative most reckful)
Full of careful heed or attention; careful; cautious.

recking.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Reck
recking.translation: v. 顾虑( reck的现在分词 )

reckless.definition:
s marked by defiant disregard for danger or consequences
s characterized by careless unconcern
reckless.translation:
a. 不介意的, 大意的, 鲁莽的, 不顾后果的
[法] 不注意的, 粗心大意的, 鲁莽的

reckless driving.translation: [法] 鲁莽驾驶, 乱开车

recklessly.translation: adv. 不注意, 粗心大意, 不在乎, 鲁莽, 不顾后果, 不顾一切, 妄动

recklessly caused loss.translation: [法] 出于轻率造成的损失

recklessness.definition: n. the trait of giving little thought to danger

reckling.definition:
a. Needing care; weak; feeble; as, a reckling child.
n. A weak child or animal.
reckling.translation: n. 一家人中的最小[最弱]者

recklinghausen.translation: 雷克林豪森[德意志联邦共和国西部城市]

recklinghausen's.translation: [医] 雷克林霍曾氏管(毛细淋巴管,角膜小管)

recklinghausen's disease.translation: [医] 雷克林霍曾氏病(多发性神经纤维瘤,囊状纤维性骨炎,畸形性关节炎)

recklinghausen's tonometer.translation: [医] 雷克林霍曾氏血压计

recklinghausen's tumor.translation: [医] 雷克林霍曾氏瘤(子宫后壁或输卵管壁的腺平滑肌纤维瘤)

recklinghausen-applebaun disease.translation: [医] 雷-阿二氏病, 血色素沉着[症]

reckon.translation:
vt. 计算, 总计, 估计, 认为, 猜想
vi. 数, 计算, 估计, 依赖, 料想

reckon for.translation: 考虑到,估计到…;说明…的理由,为…负责

reckon sth in.translation: 把某事物计算在内, 把某事物考虑在内

reckoned.translation: v. <正>计算( reckon的过去式和过去分词 ); 猜想; 考虑; <非正>思忖

reckoner.definition: n. a handbook of tables used to facilitate computation
reckoner.translation: n. 计算者, 清算人, 计算手册

reckoners.definition:
plural of reckoner
n. a handbook of tables used to facilitate computation
reckoners.translation: (reckoner 的复数) n. 计算者, 清算人, 计算手册

reckoning.definition: n. a bill for an amount due
reckoning.translation:
n. 计算, 算帐, 清算
[经] 计算, 算帐, 估计

reckoning by the abacus.translation: [经] 珠算, 用算盘计算

reckonings.definition:
n. problem solving that involves numbers or quantities
n. a bill for an amount due
n. the act of counting; reciting numbers in ascending order
reckonings.translation: n. 计算( reckoning的复数形式 ); 船只位置的推算; 账目; （尤指体育运动）属于可能胜出者行列之内

reckons.definition:
v expect, believe, or suppose
v judge to be probable
v deem to be
v make a mathematical calculation or computation
v have faith or confidence in
v take account of
reckons.translation: v. <正>计算( reckon的第三人称单数 ); 猜想; 考虑; <非正>思忖

recks.definition:
plural of reck
v. t. To make account of; to care for; to heed; to regard.
v. t. To concern; -- used impersonally.
v. i. To make account; to take heed; to care; to mind; -- often
   followed by of.
recks.translation:
(reck 的复数) vt. 介意, 和...相关
vi. 有关系, 介意
